name: Balloons
description: Hot-air balloons drifting up a valley at dawn, ray-marched: eight balloons, each a part of the spectrum, climbing with its part while its burner roars and lights the cloth from inside. Below, a patchwork of fields and hedges, woods, a river mirroring the sky, mist in the hollows thickening with the bass, and the balloons' shadows crossing the land; snow mountains far off. Night glow turns them into lanterns over a dark valley.
